Engineering - British: English, Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics; Mathematics and either Chemistry or Physics at A2; minimum overall average grades of 'A-B'. IB: English; Mathematics AA HL/SL or AI HL; 33-35. Honours Economics I - British: English; Mathematics or Further Mathematics at A2; minimum overall average grades of B.
